cost.value: a finger bone of a demon (consumed)

description.value:
You crack a demon's finger bone and hurl an abyssal bolt of void energy at a creature you can see within range. Make a spell attack roll against the target. On a hit, the bolt deals 12d6 void damage (double on a critical hit). The bolt then leaps to another creature of your choice within 30 feet of the previous target that has not already been struck by this casting; make a new spell attack roll for each subsequent target. The chain continues until you miss or no eligible target remains within 30 feet of the last target struck.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 2d6.

target.value: 1 creature, then chaining to additional creatures
